name: ESO 121-20 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 121-20, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: e12120-hubble
story: ESO 121-20 is a very isolated dwarf irregular galaxy, wrapped in an extended envelope of hydrogen gas. Hubble picked out its brightest giant stars to measure its distance for the first time.

claims.text: ESO 121-20 (KKs 19) is a very isolated dwarf irregular galaxy
It has an extended HI (hydrogen) envelope
Its distance was measured for the first time from Hubble ACS images (program 9771) using stars at the tip of the red giant branch
